label: Killer Wrath
description: Inkanyamba's wrath track. 'Increase'/'Decrease' moves the tracking marker on the Killer Wrath card (range 1–10). 'Unleash' applies the effects listed at the current level (e.g. Horror up, Inkanyamba heals or takes a Killer Action). Reduce it with Atonement Action cards.

label: Divine Wrath
description: The angry gods' track. 'Increase'/'Decrease' moves the marker on the Divine Wrath card (1–10); 'Unleash' applies the effects at the current level. In the Finale, after the Killer Action you Unleash then Increase by 1. Reduced by Atonement cards and some items.

label: Sacred space
description: Marks the Burial Ground, Sacred Shrine and Holy Groves. The more Victims on Sacred spaces, the more likely Divine Wrath is to increase.

label: Killer start space
description: The Killer's starting space on a Setup card/board. In Terror From Above the 3-bird token starts here; The Organism places the Lab token here when not at Arctic Station; The Tormentor treats a random Setup card's version as the Killer's space before he appears.

label: Spawn Birds (replaces Killer moves)
description: In Terror From Above there is no Killer, so the Killer-moves icon means spawn Birds: roll 2 dice and use the Bird Spawn card for how many and where.

label: Bird attack (replaces Killer attacks)
description: In Terror From Above the Killer-attacks icon triggers an attack in the Final Girl's space (if at least one Bird) and every space with 3 Birds. Damage = number of Birds; Victims are prioritised.

label: Window space
description: A new space type on Creech Manor (two on the right of the house, one on the left). No rules of its own, but many Terror and Event cards reference Window spaces.

label: House space
description: Maple Lane's 12 Houses (3 per NW/SW/NE/SE Quadrant). Each counts as a Search space and draws from that Quadrant's Item deck. You can't walk into an occupied House – you need a Convince Action card.

label: Searched House (X token)
description: Placed on a House once it has been successfully searched; that House can no longer be searched.

label: Track mode
description: The Big Bad Wolf starts in TRACK mode. While in this mode, resolve only the Track effects on his Terror cards (not Slay).

label: Slay mode
description: When the Dark Power is revealed the Wolf switches to SLAY mode; resolve only the Slay effects. If he switches mid-Killer phase, Slay effects start next Killer phase. 'Killing Machine' applies both modes.

label: Vanish
description: The Evomorph immediately vanishes, ending the Killer phase: remove it from the board and place it on top of the Terror deck. While vanished you draw Ambush cards instead of resolving Killer phases.

label: Scan token
description: Placed by Scan Action cards to show you've scanned a space and the Evomorph isn't hiding there. Protects against Ambushes; one per space; if none left, move the farthest one.

label: EVOLVE keyword
description: Appears on the Evomorph's Bloodlust track. When Bloodlust reaches it, move the Evolution marker to the next stage (Hatchling → Youngling → Adult) and apply that stage's rules.

label: Active Killer – move up
description: Move the Active Killer token UP to the next Killer on the board (wraps round from top to bottom). That Killer resolves the rest of the action.

label: Active Killer – move down
description: Move the Active Killer token DOWN to the next Killer (wraps round). Dead Killers are skipped.

label: Active Killer token
description: Shows which of the three Intruders is currently active. Moves when you attack a Killer, when the up/down icons are resolved, or when the active one dies.

label: +1 die (Final Health bonus)
description: The bonus gained when a Killer's Final Health is revealed. With multiple Killers (Intruders, Mutated Organisms) you only get it once, however many Killers are on their Final Health.

label: Finale (F) icon
description: Marks effects that apply once the Finale has been triggered. For The Organism, Mutated Organisms perform the extra Killer Action effects shown next to this icon after the Finale.

ruleset_name: Patsy & the Zombies (Terror From the Grave vignette)
label: Spawn Zombies
description: Spawn the number of Zombies shown at the current Bloodlust level, one per Exit space starting with the space with fewest Zombies. Source icon is tiny, so this image is low resolution.

ruleset_name: Patsy & the Zombies (Terror From the Grave vignette)
label: Vehicle / own driver
description: On the board: a face-down Vehicle token, revealed when you first enter its Exit space. On a Vehicle Action card title: the vehicle has its own pilot/driver, so you needn't be in its space to use it.

label: Vehicle: Motorboat (Camp Happy Trails)
description: Lets you travel by water to any space bordering the lake or the lake centre. Victims may follow. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Golf Cart (Carnival of Blood)
description: Victims may not drive it but may follow; you can drive it to every space ignoring normal restrictions. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Helicopter (Creech Manor)
description: Has a pilot – you needn't be with it to use its Vehicle Action card. Outdoor spaces only. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Police Car (Maple Lane)
description: Has a driver; Street spaces only. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Super Loader (USS Konrad)
description: May not move through Maintenance Shafts. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Skidozer (Arctic Station 2891)
description: Outdoor spaces only. Next to the Lab with no Zombies in your space you can place the 'Hole' token for 2 Time. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Scooter (Wingard Cottage)
description: Outdoor spaces only; Victims may follow. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Raft (Storybook Woods)
description: Place the 4 Raft tokens touching the river and a non-exit space; moves only along the river token to token. Victims won't follow. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Vehicle: Gurney (Wolfe Asylum)
description: May move with you anywhere on the board. Vehicle rules come from the Patsy & the Zombies vignette (Terror From the Grave); this vehicle appears on this location.

label: Helicopter moves
description: The Helicopter moves 1 space along the Helicopter card track (between Station 2891 and Arctic Airport). Mainly from the 'Fly Faster' Action card.

label: Frostbite
description: You, each Victim and each Enemy in an outdoor space gain a Frostbite token, or lose 1 health if they already have one. Frostbite tokens are discarded in Upkeep for anyone indoors.

label: Raft token
description: A Raft item: choose 4 spaces where the raft can go ashore (touching the river and a non-exit space) and travel between them along the river.

label: Keycard token
description: Spend Time to pick up when you start/end in its space (gives you a Keycard Item). Spend by placing on a Maintenance Shaft to open it, or on a Maintenance card to activate a ship function. Free to use; can't be retrieved.

label: Maintenance space
description: Purple spaces (Trash Compactor, Furnace, Hangar, Bridge). Be here to place Keycards on the matching Maintenance card: Crusher, Incinerator, Airlock, Self Destruct.

label: Self Destruct countdown
description: Placed on the Self Destruct Maintenance card once activated; counts down to the ship exploding. Get to an Escape Pod in time – if the Killer dies with you, you still lose.

label: Super Loader token
description: Starts in the Hangar. Usable only with the Super Loader Key Item. Unequip it or lose the key and the token stays in your current space.

label: Supply: Discarded Tools
description: Supply Item symbol on the board. While in that space, spend 1 Time to take the Discarded Tools Supply card for crafting.

label: Supply: Nails
description: Supply Item symbol. Spend 1 Time in this space to take the Nails Supply card.

label: Supply: Rope
description: Supply Item symbol. Spend 1 Time in this space to take the Rope Supply card.

label: Supply: Wood
description: Supply Item symbol. Spend 1 Time in this space to take the Wood Supply card.

label: Stun token
description: Placed under a Stunned Enemy: next Killer phase it ignores all Killer-moves icons (but still attacks). Discarded in Upkeep.

label: Pill token / White pill
description: End movement in its space and spend 1 Time to pick it up and place it under your Pill Effects card. Consume during the Action phase for effects, then draw Side Effects.

label: Pill: Yellow
description: One of 3 yellow pills. See the Pill Effects card; taking one of each colour lets you draw an Amped card.

label: Pill: Wild
description: The single wild pill – counts as any colour.

label: Destiny symbol
description: Resolve the effect shown on the Death Order card. Killer Actions on Terror cards count as Destiny symbols. Ignore one with Thwart Destiny.

label: Death token
description: Back of the 5 Death tokens on the Death Order card; they set the order Fated Victims must be saved in and are flipped by Fated Death Terror cards.

label: Final Girl Noise
description: The Eyeless targets you if your Noise level ≥ this number AND he can reach you with his movement; otherwise use the card's 'Otherwise' effect.

label: Countdown token
description: Two sit under the Cybernetic Parts on the back of the Finale. Once all parts are gone, remove one each Killer phase and increase Bloodlust; the second brings in Mark X.

label: Cybernetic Part
description: Each destroyed part (2 damage in one phase) is rolled out on the board near Mark V. Spend Time to pick up; spend more to re-install them and repair Mark V as an Ally.

label: Pull into the Mirror Dimension
description: Slayer targets the closest Victim in Our Dimension and pulls them into the Mirror Dimension (swap to a grey meeple, panic them). If none, increase Bloodlust instead.

label: Victim Death Trap
description: Draw a Victim Death Trap card and trap the target Victim; they can't move and must escape via the card's Escape Tasks.

label: Final Girl Death Trap
description: Draw a Final Girl Death Trap card: you're Trapped. Reach the end of the trap and you die.

label: Progress Death Traps
description: Advance the meeples on all active Death Traps one space and apply that space's effect.

label: Bottom this Terror card
description: Place this Terror card face down at the bottom of the Terror deck.

label: Roll the d20
description: Roll the 20-sided die.

label: Hellscape tile: star
description: One of the 4 double-sided Hellscape tile symbols, used by Hellscape dice and Shift/Swap/Flip/Rearrange effects. Small source, so low resolution.

label: Hellscape tile: circle
description: Hellscape tile symbol (see star).

label: Hellscape tile: bars
description: Hellscape tile symbol (see star).

label: Hellscape tile: cog
description: Hellscape tile symbol (see star).

label: Hellscape dice
description: Rolled each Upkeep: matching symbols Flip that tile; different symbols Swap the indicated tiles.

label: Locked token
description: Placed on an Exit space; no Victims can be saved there until Unlocked. Used by Marrek Warehouse and the Tormentor's 'No Escape!' Finale.

label: Rack space
description: Tops of the warehouse storage racks. Enemies and Victims move between them normally; you need Climb to get up and Leap to jump between them.

label: Sinkhole
description: When a space Collapses, Victims there are killed; you and any Enemies there take damage and panic out. A Sinkhole token is placed: no one can enter or pass through that space for the rest of the game.

label: Boulder space
description: Safe from Sand Snake attacks; some cards reference them.

label: Savior start space
description: Where the Savior (orange Special Victim meeple) starts, per the Setup card.

label: Railing space
description: Overlooks the Food Court. You or an Ally can jump down (roll: 5–6 safe, 1–4 take damage). Anyone damaged here falls to the Food Court below and takes extra damage.

label: Spawn Birds (claw)
description: The bird-claw icon on Terror From Above cards. Like the boot, it means spawn Birds: roll 2 dice and use the Bird Spawn card.

label: Sacred Groves token: warning
description: One of the 5 Sacred Groves tokens. The rule sheet only lists them as 'various tokens' – the card that places it explains what it does.

label: Sacred Groves token: sign (x2)
description: Two of the 5 Sacred Groves tokens. Effect explained on the card that places it.

label: Sacred Groves token: fire
description: One of the 5 Sacred Groves tokens. Effect explained on the card that places it.

label: Sacred Groves token: burst
description: One of the 5 Sacred Groves tokens. Effect explained on the card that places it.

label: Pill: Blue
description: One of 3 blue pills (see Pill Effects card). Partly hidden on the sheet, so recoloured from the yellow pill – same shape, true blue.

label: Pill: Pink
description: One of 3 pink pills (see Pill Effects card). Partly hidden on the sheet, so recoloured from the yellow pill.

label: Arrow token
description: Sits above the Consequence cards and moves right each time a Death token is resolved, always matching the next Death token on the Death Order card. A killed Fated Victim goes on the Consequence card under the Arrow.

label: Noise marker
description: Tracks your Noise level on the Time track. +1 per Action card resolved in the Action phase, plus Item noise. Resets to 0 at the end of Upkeep.

label: Noise card (+1 / +3)
description: Tucked under an Item as a reminder: +1 Noise = heard in the same space (melee etc.), +3 = heard at a distance (guns, whistles, vehicles). Silent items get no card. Tiny source, low resolution.

label: Death Trap skull space
description: A space on a Death Trap card. When a Trapped meeple advances onto it, apply that effect (e.g. increase Horror).

label: Death Trap final space
description: The last space of a Death Trap. A Victim reaching it dies (Bloodlust up, apply Fail Result); the Final Girl reaching it dies and loses immediately.

label: Bloodlust Track token (A)
description: Pink 'A' bear token. At setup the A and B tokens are shuffled face down by type and 6 are placed on matching spaces of Billy's Bloodlust track (1 of each type is left unused, unseen). When Bloodlust reaches a space with a token, flip it and apply its effect.

label: Bloodlust Track token (B)
description: Blue 'B' bear token. Works exactly like the A tokens: placed face down on the matching Bloodlust spaces and revealed for its effect when Bloodlust reaches it.

label: Power Source (Active)
description: Green battery side of a Power Source token. 4 start Active on separate, non-adjacent spaces (the 5th is set aside). While at least one is Active, Billy can recharge. Spend 1 Time in (or moving through) its space to Deactivate it.

label: Power Source (Inactive)
description: Red crossed-out side of a Power Source token, showing it has been Deactivated. Some effects may Activate it again (flip back to green).

label: Billy recharges
description: Battery-with-heart icon on cards. Billy recovers 1 health as long as at least one Power Source is still Active; ignore it if none are.

label: Arcade space
description: Purple arcade-cabinet icon marking the 4 Arcade spaces in the middle of the Buddyland board. Card effects (e.g. the Arcade Token item) refer to these spaces.

label: Harvest Madness
description: Grinning pumpkin. Move the Harvest Madness marker 1 space right on Grimlash's board. On reaching a new level (1-3), draw 2 Harvest Madness cards for that level and keep 1. Your Horror Rolls are -1 at level 0-1, normal at 2, +1 at 3. When healing you may lower Madness instead of recovering health.

label: Harvest Madness - skull space
description: The skull at the end of the Harvest Madness track. If your Madness goes past Level 3 onto this space, you immediately lose the game.

label: Children Action
description: Red sickle icon marking the Children's own action line. The Children act at the start of the Killer phase, before any Minion or Killer Action, one at a time from the Child closest to the Altar of the Old Gods outwards.

label: Children Action token
description: The token carrying the Children's action line. At setup, place it above any Minion or Killer Actions on the Finale card so the Children always act first.

label: Abduction
description: Grasping-hands icon. A Child on a space with a Victim rolls a die: 1-2 the Victim is sacrificed (killed, Bloodlust up, Child returns to the Altar, Victim goes on the Ancient Curse card); 3-6 it fails. With no Victim present, treat it as a normal attack. 3 sacrifices reveal an Ancient Curse.

label: Field space
description: Wheat-sheaf icon marking Field spaces at Shady Acres. Many cards target Field spaces, and Event/Item effects (e.g. Field tokens, the Combine) can add or remove them.

label: Divine Blessing
description: Dove icon (mainly from the Expel Demon action). Place a black Final Health token face down on the next empty space of the Divine Blessings sheet and apply that space's effect. After killing possessed Ursula, reveal these tokens: any health on them restores her and you win; all blank and you lose.

label: Blessed die
description: White die. When this icon appears, swap 1 normal die for the Blessed die on Horror Rolls. Blessed and Cursed icons cancel one for one; you never roll both together.

label: Cursed die
description: Black die. Swap 1 normal die for the Cursed die on Horror Rolls. Also used whenever you roll Horror while standing on a Malice token. Cancels against Blessed icons one for one.

label: Cursed die - wound face
description: The slashed face on the Cursed die. If your final Horror Roll shows this result, you lose 1 health. (Improvise effects also apply to the Cursed die's 5.)

label: Malice
description: Red spiked-star icon. Place a Malice token in the Active Killer's space (or the nearest space to the Killer without one). Rolling Horror on a Malice space uses the Cursed die. If all 14 are placed and you need another, you lose. Benediction actions remove them.

label: Malice token
description: The physical Malice token. 4 start on the board (Killer's start space plus 3 adjacent). Each shows a Cursed-die symbol as a reminder that Horror Rolls on that space use the Cursed die.

label: Donkey token
description: Placed in the Cloister space at setup. Card effects at L'Armes Abbey refer to it.

label: Add to Path (face up)
description: Eye icon. Draw a Movement card and add it face up to the end of the Volk'ar's Path, so you can see part of her hidden route.

label: Add to Path (face down) / Conceal
description: Crossed-out eye. Draw a Movement card and add it face down. If she is Visible, she becomes Concealed: Origin marker on the new card and her current space, meeple back onto the Finale card. While Concealed, Killer Action lines on cards count as this icon.

label: Reveal
description: Purple ornate icon. Resolve the Volk'ar's Path: place her meeple at the Origin, then resolve each Movement card in order (moving and attacking as shown) and discard them. Her Path also resolves when a 6th card is added or when an attack on her Concealed position does damage.

label: Attack token
description: Crosshair token. When attacking the Concealed Volk'ar, place it on the space you are guessing and record damage on the Attack Resolution card. If her Path ends on that space, the damage lands; if not, the attack misses and you suffer the Ambush Penalty.

label: Damage token
description: Yellow-star token placed on the Attack Resolution card to record the damage from an attack on the Concealed Volk'ar until you know whether you hit. Discarded afterwards. (Cropped from a stack of tokens, so one edge shows a faint overlap.)

label: Origin marker
description: Skull-helmet marker (2 of them). One sits on the first Movement card of the Path, the other on the board space where her hidden movement starts. While Concealed, effects that count from the Killer use the Origin space instead.

label: Starting Upgrade (Unlocked)
description: Green star. Marks the 2 starting Soldier Upgrades (one Move and one Attack action), which begin the game on their Unlocked side. The other 6 start Locked.

label: Upgrade - Locked
description: Red padlock. A Soldier Upgrade not yet available. Unlock it with the Train action; some effects Lock Upgrades again.

label: Huey token
description: Helicopter token that starts in the Clearing. Its space counts as an exit: save any number of Victims there in one go, then remove the Huey (the Clearing is no longer an exit unless an effect brings it back).

label: River space
description: Blue wave icon marking the 4 River spaces (Waterfall, Upper, Central, Lower River). Moving downriver costs 1 movement to reach any River space; you, Victims and Soldiers can do this, but Enemies only drift one space. No one can move upriver.

label: Piranhas! token
description: Placed on a River space by the 'Piranhas!' Event (1-2 Lower, 3-4 Central, 5-6 Upper River). Everyone there loses health, and anyone entering that space later loses health too.

label: Join the Pack (target the Pack)
description: Red raptor-pack icon. Individual Raptors move towards the Pack. Any Raptor ending in the Pack's space joins it immediately: remove the meeple and add 1 health to the Pack.

label: Raptors stop
description: Red octagon reminder. Moving Raptors stop as soon as they enter (or start in) a space with you or a Victim. Applies even on Location Terror cards that don't show it.

label: Spawn Raptors
description: Egg icon. Draw a Spawn card and place that many individual Raptors, rolling on the Raptors card's spawn table for where. If you run out of meeples, the Raptor nearest the Pack joins it to free one up.

label: T-Rex advances
description: Flaming footprint. Move the T-Rex 1 space right on the T-Rex card. At 'Break out!' it goes into the Dino Pen and its action token goes on the Finale card; ignore further footprints.

label: T-Rex stops at ANYONE
description: Red 'ANY' stop sign. While moving, the T-Rex (movement 2) stops in the first space containing anyone - you, Victims or Enemies - and won't move at all if someone is already in its space.

label: Volcano
description: Volcano icon. First time: everyone at the Volcano takes damage, anyone left there panics, and the Volcano Lava token makes it impassable. After that, each icon draws a Lava card to spread lava to another space. Ignore once all 4 Lava tokens are out.

label: Beach space
description: Yellow sunrise icon marking the 3 Beach spaces at the corners of the board. Card effects refer to them.

label: Cliff space
description: Red cliff icon marking the 2 Cliff spaces at the board edges. Card effects refer to them.

label: Electric Fence marker
description: Blocks the path it sits on, so the spaces either side stop being adjacent (panics are blocked, distances route round it, Enemies with no clear path stay put). Each Upkeep, roll the Fence die and toggle that fence on or off.

label: Electric Fence die
description: Rolled every Upkeep phase to pick which of fences A, B or C changes: if its marker is there, remove it; if not, place it.

label: T-Rex Action token
description: Placed under the Killer Action on the Finale card once the T-Rex breaks out. The T-Rex acts after the Minion and Killer Actions: it moves and instantly kills one target in its space (priority Victim, Minion, you, Killer). It can't be attacked.

ruleset_name: Mort the Teenage Dirtbag (Shriek Special Feature)
label: Active Killer (draw a Suspect)
description: Screaming-mask icon. Draw a Suspect token from the bag; that Suspect is the Active Killer for this action. If the Suspect has already been cleared by a Clue, ignore the action and discard the token; otherwise return it to the bag. Location cards that make the Killer act count as having this icon.

ruleset_name: Mort the Teenage Dirtbag (Shriek Special Feature)
label: Horror Track token
description: Starts on Mort's Killer board. When Bloodlust hits the top of the track, move it onto the splat at the end of your Horror track: from then on, Horror above maximum costs you Time instead of health.

ruleset_name: Mega Board Game Con (Shriek Special Feature)
label: Exhibit Area space
description: Yellow spade icon on the vendor-booth spaces. Victims will not follow you out of an Exhibit Area into a General Area; use Create a Panic or wait for them to panic. Searching here uses the Exhibit Area item deck.

ruleset_name: Mega Board Game Con (Shriek Special Feature)
label: Hallway / dock fast move
description: Blue double arrow linking hallway and dock spaces. If your first step goes along one of these links, you get +1 success on the Action card granting the movement.

label: Skull token
description: Skull board token from the Buddyland box. The rule sheet doesn't explain it; the card that places it says what it does.

label: Unidentified token (dark)
description: Dark board token from the Buddyland box. It's printed too small on the rule sheet to make out and isn't explained there; check the card that places it.

label: Unidentified token (brown)
description: Brown board token from the Buddyland box. It's printed too small on the rule sheet to make out and isn't explained there; check the card that places it.

label: Green token (x3)
description: One of three identical green board tokens from the Buddyland box. The rule sheet doesn't explain them; the card that places them says what they do.

label: Parachute token
description: Parachute (supply drop) board token from the Isla Lagarto box. The rule sheet doesn't explain it; the card that places it says what it does.

label: Goat token
description: Tethered goat board token from the Isla Lagarto box. The rule sheet doesn't explain it; the card that places it says what it does.

label: Tail token
description: Dinosaur-tail board token from the Isla Lagarto box. The rule sheet doesn't explain it; the card that places it says what it does.

ruleset_name: Mega Board Game Con (Shriek Special Feature)
label: Shopping bag token
description: Shopping bag board token from the Mega Board Game Con box. The rule sheet doesn't explain it; the card that places it says what it does.

ruleset_name: Mega Board Game Con (Shriek Special Feature)
label: Wet floor sign token
description: Warning / wet-floor sign board token from the Mega Board Game Con box. The rule sheet doesn't explain it; the card that places it says what it does.

ruleset_name: Mega Board Game Con (Shriek Special Feature)
label: Price tag token
description: Price tag ($) board token from the Mega Board Game Con box. The rule sheet doesn't explain it; the card that places it says what it does.

ruleset_name: Mega Board Game Con (Shriek Special Feature)
label: Crowd token
description: Crowd (group of people) board token from the Mega Board Game Con box. The rule sheet doesn't explain it; the card that places it says what it does.

label: Unidentified token (brown)
description: Brown round token from the Pesadilla Verde box. It's printed too small on the rule sheet to make out and isn't explained there; check the card that places it.

label: Unidentified token (grey)
description: Grey round token from the Pesadilla Verde box. It's printed too small on the rule sheet to make out and isn't explained there; check the card that places it.

label: Field token
description: Yellow token showing the Field icon. Cards such as the Event 'The Fields Are Moving...' place it on a space (e.g. Hayfield, Cow Pasture), turning that space into a Field space.

label: Combine token (likely)
description: Grey vehicle-shaped token, most likely the Combine placed by the Combine Keys item: move with it for an extra space on Walk actions, harvesting Field spaces it enters. Identified from the card, not the rule sheet.

label: Unidentified token (dark)
description: Dark round token from the Shady Acres box. It's printed too small on the rule sheet to make out and isn't explained there; check the card that places it.

label: Harvested token (x3)
description: Ploughed-furrow token (3 in the box). Placed when the Combine enters a Field space: that space is no longer a Field space.
